shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && ls -a && find specs -maxdepth 2 -name spec.md 2>/dev/null && cat .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null && rg --files | rg '\\.test\\.' | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && cat package.json && git status --short --branch && ls -la .lore"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts; sed -n '1,160p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md; sed -n '1,100p' .specify/spec.md; sed -n '1,120p' jest.config.js; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/example/weather-tool.ts 2>/dev/null; rg \"ToolRegistry|ToolDefinition\" src"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git status -sb'
